svg.aria-label: Weight-for-age: a girl crossing centiles downward
svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Weight-for-age: a girl crossing centiles downward
svg.desc: WHO weight-for-age chart for a girl, 0 to 24 months: her weight is near the 75th centile at 2 months, then gains little from 6 months, crossing down to the 6th percentile at 15 months (8.0 kg).
